description: Step 2 of 3: searches for each part: on GitHub the topic's most starred and rising repos, names and descriptions holding each keyword, and README text; on GitLab and Codeberg the topic and the keywords. Returns what it found, with stars, license, language, last activity and how each turned up, to pick each part's verdict and candidates from. Then call git_for_me_verify.

keywords.description: 1 or 2 words a fitting repo's name or description might hold, such as "pdf"

language.description: Only repos in this language, such as "python", or in any of several, comma-separated, such as "typescript, javascript"; leave it out to search all

phrase.description: The job in a few words, as a README would put it, such as "extract tables from pdf"

topic.description: The topic the job falls under, as repos are tagged: lowercase and hyphenated, such as "pdf-parser"

name: git_for_me_search
title: Git for me! (searched live)
